steps.t: 📱 One real send from your iPhone — it should land in Daraja HQ
steps.why: Send to Claude now posts the whole report straight into Daraja HQ (new HQ script, pasted 4 Oct). Prove it on a real iPhone: send one report, then look for it in Daraja HQ → The stack.
how: Open Feedback Studio with Our Table inside (link).
Point at anything, say one sentence.
✅ I'm done → 📨 Send to Claude. It should say “✅ Sent. Thank you”.
Open Daraja HQ → The stack: your report is there. Tell me “report arrived”.

steps.t: 🎭 Dress rehearsal: every device plays a stranger; Daraja HQ is the control room
steps.where: An afternoon, the devices charged, the printed kit.
steps.why: Five pretend testers (Ruth on the iPad, Pastor Dan on the laptop, Linda and Sam on phones, Veronica for Zuri) run the whole loop: sign up → tour → use → report → it lands in Daraja HQ → the Wasaidizi draft replies → fix
how: Print the Dress Rehearsal Kit (one persona card per device).
Each device: a private window, follow its card.
At the Mac: tick the control-room checklist in Daraja HQ.
Tell Claude “here’s what we found”.

steps.t: 🛠 Tell Claude what the rehearsal found → fixes ship
steps.why: Whatever stalled in the rehearsal gets fixed the same night, and the fixed apps show it in What’s New.
how: Say “here’s what we found” and list it, or just “work the stack”.
Approve the plan; I fix, test twice, ship.

steps.where: In the Claude chat. One minute.
steps.why: The store stays in test mode (nothing for sale yet) and gets a Founding Testers banner: 30 days free, keep the apps forever. I check every link before saying it’s done.
how: Say “launch the test store”.
Open the store and check the banner (link).

steps.t: 📣 Find 100 Founding Testers: texts Mon, Facebook Tue, church Wed
steps.where: Your phone. The kit has every word.
steps.why: The deal: 30 days free, tell us what’s confusing, keep the apps forever. The sign-up page is live and every sign-up lands in Daraja HQ with how they heard. All the words are written in the Marketing Kit, plus a printable
how: Mon: text 20 people you know (copy in the kit).
Tue: your Facebook post (copy in the kit).
Wed: church bulletin blurb + 5 flyers on the table.
While away: one Facebook group post every few days (Claude drafts each).
Say “how are sign-ups doing?” any time.

steps.t: 🏈 Invite the two ESPN leagues to try My Scores
steps.where: Your phone for the text, or the Mac for the email. About ten minutes.
steps.why: My Scores is live and free while testing. The text and the email are written and ready, with the 2-minute video link and the 10-second setup (both leagues are one-tap buttons in the app, so nobody pastes anything). They
how: Open the message file (link) and pick the text or the email version.
Text: copy the box below, paste it into a group message to each league. Email: copy the email version from the file.
Tell me "invite sent" and I will watch for replies and feedback (say "read my feedback" or check the Testers' List).
Optional: ask me to make a real MP4 video for it, like Our Table's.
